reason: The initial fixed-entry action policies rarely trigger PS01 and do not deliberately seek guard-to-placement sequences. Check this specific limitation before deciding whether the minimum-time case needs a nerf.
sequence_policy: Use the same public-state AH progress policy as fallback, preserving its healing choice and currently lethal attacks.
With at least two equipped PS01 copies, prefer a currently available non-healing placement costing at most 3 if the after-guard flag is armed.
Otherwise, if no guard is active and a non-healing placement of a different attribute is currently available, prefer a matching guard to arm a following placement.
No private hand, future draw, enemy action or future board state is read. The expected next placement can be disrupted before the next player turn.
This deliberate probe is not an optimal planner. Effects, costs, inventory and seeds are not adjusted after observing its results.
